findings.correction: Jin Wikyung’s face darkened. It was then that the First Elder’s Sword Energy, rushing forward without pause, suddenly changed direction.
findings.current: It was then that the First Elder’s Sword Energy, advancing without resistance, suddenly changed direction.
findings.defect: Omits Jin Wikyung’s darkened expression, the timing beat that frames the redirected strike.
findings.rationale: The source times the next attack to Wikyung’s darkened look, not only to the Sword Energy’s turn.

findings.correction: His youngest brother—so precious he could put him in his eye and feel no pain—was blocking the Head Elder.
findings.current: His youngest brother—the brother so precious that he could put him in his eye without feeling pain—was facing the Head Elder.
findings.defect: 막고 있다 is blocking/intercepting the Head Elder, not merely facing him.
findings.rationale: Wikyung’s panic is that Taekyung is standing in the Head Elder’s way, which is why delay is fatal.
findings.source: 눈에 넣어도 아프지 않을 막냇동생이 대장로를 막고 있다.

findings.correction: The First Elder was a despicable old monster who had lived more than sixty years while concealing his dark intent.
findings.current: The First Elder was a despicable old monster who had lived for more than sixty years while concealing his true ambition.
findings.defect: 흑심 is hidden malice or a black heart, not ambition; this chapter later rejects wealth, glory, and rule as the motive.
findings.rationale: Ambition prejudges the later exchange in which Wikyung denies that the plan was for wealth, glory, or becoming a provincial ruler.
findings.source: 일장로는 일 갑자를 넘게 살아오며 흑심을 감춰 왔던 비열한 노괴(老怪)다.

findings.correction: What does age matter when it comes to life and death? Anyone who stands at the tip of a blade is a person of Murim.
findings.current: A martial artist stands at the tip of a blade.
findings.defect: 무림인 is a person of Murim; 무인 is the glossary default for martial artist. The bound term Murim is missing.
findings.rationale: Exact glossary match requires Murim for 무림; the line’s point is Murim identity at the blade’s tip, not generic martial-artist status.

findings.defect: The stammer is 일장로, the First Elder’s title, not a generic Elder.
findings.rationale: He is naming the man who just cut him, the First Elder, while his voice fails.

findings.correction: And in that interval, two people did not miss the opening.
findings.current: And in that opening, two people did not hesitate.
findings.defect: 빈틈을 놓치지 않는 means they did not miss the gap; hesitation is not the source verb.
findings.rationale: The next beats are Wipeng’s side cut and the three-sword follow-up; the mechanism is exploiting the Elders’ fluster, not generic resolve.
findings.source: 그리고 그사이, 빈틈을 놓치지 않는 두 사람이 있었다.

findings.correction: After living so many years, they had achieved much, and they had much they needed to protect.
findings.current: After living for so many years, they had built things and found things they needed to protect.
findings.defect: 이뤄 온 것 is what they had achieved; 지켜야 할 것 is what they had to protect. “Found things” is not in the source.
findings.rationale: The fear of a dog’s death is grounded in accomplishments and duties already held, not in things they happened to find.
findings.source: 적지 않은 세월을 살아온 만큼 이뤄 온 것도, 지켜야 할 것도 많았다.

findings.correction: What are you doing? Those Jin Family bastards are right in front of us—
findings.current: What are you doing? The Jin Family’s right in front of us—
findings.defect: 놈들 is a slur; the Mount Heng speaker is cursing the Jin Family, not naming them neutrally.
findings.rationale: The reply about “those black bastards” is answering a contemptuous line; dropping 놈들 flattens the speaker’s register.
findings.source: 자네 뭐 하고 있나! 태원진가 놈들이 코앞에 있는데…….

findings.correction: They had just fought the Peak masters of the Mount Heng Sword Sect, and that made it even worse.
findings.current: They had just fought the Peak masters of the Mount Heng Sword Sect, and the exhaustion was taking its toll.
findings.defect: The source only says the retreat was worse because the Peak fight had just happened; it does not name exhaustion.
findings.rationale: Adding exhaustion inserts a cause the Korean leaves implicit.
findings.source: 앞서 항산검문의 절정 고수들을 상대한 직후인지라 더더욱 그랬다.

findings.defect: 푹 is a piercing/stabbing sound, not a blunt impact.
findings.rationale: The following line is Sword Energy driving through flesh, bone, and blood vessels from the back.

findings.defect: The thought has no curse; 무슨 is “what is this,” and “hell” adds profanity.
findings.rationale: Wikyung’s earlier “what the hell kind of internal energy” is backed by 놈; this beat is not.

summary: The draft tracks the fight and raid turn, but several action, motive, address, and terminology errors are actionable; the largest are the omitted darkened-face beat, Taekyung merely “facing” the Head Elder, and 흑심 rendered as ambition.
